reasons: Only one of five sections was included in the packet, so the helpers are unreviewed.
A test file exists that exercises these helpers.

terms.meaning: the result of one verification check, such as potential issue or insufficient evidence

sections.name: File setup, VerificationSummary, VerificationSource
sections.title: Types for verification display
sections.what: Defines the summary of counts per outcome and the shape of a source entry with its id, label and type.
sections.why: Likely reason: gives the verification display a fixed shape for counts and sources. Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: Summary counts must cover every outcome type, or the page will miss some counts.

sections.name: summarizeVerification
sections.title: Counting check outcomes
sections.what: Counts how many checks passed, had a potential issue, or lacked enough evidence. The result is a small set of three numbers that a summary display can show.
sections.why: Gives the screen totals without the page needing to loop over the checks itself.
sections.watch_out: If a check has an outcome other than the three expected values, its count becomes NaN and nothing reports the problem.

sections.name: sourcesForVerification
sections.title: Finding source documents for a check
sections.what: For one check, looks up each source document it refers to and returns its id, title and type. If a document cannot be found, it returns an empty entry that keeps only the id.
sections.why: Lets a check show where its evidence came from.
sections.watch_out: A missing document produces a blank label and type, so the screen may show an empty row rather than an error.

sections.name: outcomePresentation
sections.title: Styling and label for each outcome
sections.what: Maps each outcome to a colour class, a symbol and a label key. Potential issues get a warning style, insufficient evidence gets a review style, and everything else gets the passed style.
sections.why: Keeps colours and symbols consistent across the screen.
sections.watch_out: Any unexpected outcome shows as passed with a tick mark, which could hide a real problem.

summary: Turns verification results into the summary counts, the source list and the display style for each outcome.
purpose: Lets the verification page show counts, sources and colours from one set of helpers.
why: Reason not stated in the code. Only the first section was included in the packet.
how: Defines the summary and source shapes. Other helpers summarize outcomes, collect sources for a result, and return the style for an outcome. Only the type definitions are visible here.
inputs: Verification results and document lists, as described by the helpers in the rest of the file.
outputs: Summary counts, source lists and display styles.
risks: Unclear from the visible code, since only the type definitions were included.
debug: Check the verification results shape first, then the helper that produces the bad value.
